notes:
FICTIONAL PATIENT FOR SOFTWARE TESTING ONLY

Patient: Synthetic Rowan Blake
Age: 52 years
Clinic record number: SYN-RB-1016
Date of service: 16 October 2026
Visit: In-person gastroenterology office visit. This is an established patient who was seen by this same gastroenterologist five months ago.

S - Subjective
Synthetic Rowan Blake reports intermittent epigastric pain after large meals for 10 days. Episodes last about 20 minutes and the pain is rated 4 out of 10. The patient also reports abdominal bloating for three weeks. The patient denies heartburn, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty swallowing, vomiting, hematemesis, black stools, rectal bleeding and unintentional weight loss. No daily medicines or supplements are reported.

O - Objective
Blood pressure 118/74 mmHg, pulse 72 beats per minute, temperature 36.7 degrees Celsius. The patient is alert and in no acute distress. The abdomen is soft with mild epigastric tenderness. There is no rebound tenderness or guarding. No laboratory testing, imaging, endoscopy or other procedure was performed at this encounter.

A - Assessment
1. Epigastric pain.
2. Abdominal bloating.
Both epigastric pain and bloating were evaluated and discussed during this encounter.
The cause of these symptoms has not been established. GERD, gastritis, peptic ulcer disease and irritable bowel syndrome have not been diagnosed.

P - Plan
Discussed smaller meals and keeping a food and symptom diary. Requested the previous gastroenterology records. No medication was prescribed today. Further testing will be considered after review of the prior records; no procedure has been ordered or performed today. Follow up in three weeks. The patient was advised to seek prompt assessment for severe or worsening pain, vomiting blood, black stools or fainting.

Total physician time on the date of service was 24 minutes, including review of available records, obtaining history, performing the examination, counseling and documentation. This total excludes clinical staff time and time for separately reported services. Office E/M selection is based on total physician time.

cell_0.meaning: The patient's full name only, exactly as documented and unambiguously stated in the clinical source. This destination requires the documented patient name; no registry, demographic fallback or signature may be used.

cell_1.meaning: The patient's age as a whole number of years, as documented in the clinical source.

cell_2.meaning: The single clinic record number or identifier for the patient, exactly as documented in the clinical source.

cell_3.meaning: The calendar date of the service or consultation. Accept only a complete, unambiguous calendar date with an explicit year, preserving the documented spelling. No printed date format is specified.

cell_4.meaning: A concise narrative stating both the setting of the visit as documented and the patient's status for the visit as documented. Both parts are required; no printed choices are provided, so none are assumed.

cell_5.meaning: The Subjective section of the SOAP note: the patient's reported symptoms, concerns, reason for visit and relevant history as documented in the clinical source, including reported negatives. Contains only what is documented.

cell_6.meaning: The Objective section of the SOAP note: examination findings, measurements and results documented as observed at this encounter, including documented normal or negative findings. No normal ranges are inferred.

cell_7.meaning: The clinician's assessment or impression: one or more documented findings or diagnoses, preserving any stated diagnostic uncertainty (such as suspected, probable or possible) and any explicitly excluded or ruled-out conditions. Only the relevant clinical answer, not unrelated note content.

cell_8.meaning: The documented plan of care and follow-up: planned investigations, treatments, advice and referrals. Any follow-up timing is recorded as relative text as documented (for example a review interval), never as an invented calendar date.

cell_9.meaning: The medicines the patient is currently taking, as documented in the clinical source, including dose or frequency where documented. Past or discontinued medicines are not included unless documented as current.

cell_10.meaning: The patient's documented allergies, including reactions where documented, or an explicitly documented statement that no allergies are known. Absence of documentation is not a negative statement.

cell_11.meaning: The patient's documented family history: conditions documented in the patient's relatives, with the relationship where documented, or an explicitly documented statement of no relevant family history.

cell_12.meaning: The total physician time spent on the date of service, as a whole number of minutes, as documented in the clinical source.

cell_13.meaning: A concise statement of the documented basis for the evaluation and management (E/M) level selection, such as the medical decision making or total time documented. Only the documented basis is stated; no level is inferred.
